```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
Below is the dataset for rhinovirus in the UK in 2026.
```{r}
disease <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(disease))
```
```{r}
disease <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
ggplot(disease, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
  ))  +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Metric_value") +
  ggtitle("Rhinovirus in the UK")


```
